elements.problem: 'Lasts >= 10 minutes' is a duration. Encoded as the vague 'Prolonged' qualifier and as (>= (onset Chest pain) (time_ago 10 minutes)), which tests when pain began (within the last 10 minutes), the opposite direction and a different quantity. Stable angina rule uses (<= onset ...) and inherits the same confusion; the two rules can both be true or both false for the same onset.

summary: Most consequential: the 'lasts >= 10 minutes' criterion is encoded as an onset comparison (wrong quantity, and opposite directions in the ACS and stable angina rules), and two of the five 'chest pain any of' criteria (not relieved by rest/nitrates, more often than usual) are missing. The danger-sign list and ECG/positional logic are otherwise well captured. Shock likely (footnote 5) is not encoded.
